svg.title: The Capital Suite. Building AI for real work.
svg.desc: Animated pixel-arcade banner. The headline Building AI for real work types in, followed by Read more here: thecapitalsuite.co and a blinking Press Start prompt. On the right, an overview of work: production-grade agents, a frontier-market lens on AI, startups and capital, and building notes. A tape along the bottom scrolls: Read the newsletter, thecapitalsuite.co, See agents in production, thecapitalsuite.co/agents.
